status: registered follow-up to known results (not an original registration)
deviations: Bootstrap means are NaN-aware (a context with no value for a statistic is skipped within a resample); with no missing values, as in the registered 150, this is identical to the registered estimand.

The per-context geometry (t_j, p, u_j) is recomputed in this script with the same tang/unit functions and pool rule as olmo_direction_analysis.per_context (which returns only scalars); it is checked against per_context's projections on s (max deviation reported) and s = unit(f - (f.p)p) is asserted.
Even k: the two halves of a split are interchangeable, so a partition is counted once (halves containing the first continuation); odd k: the floor-sized half identifies the partition.
Bisection: if mean r_c exceeds the value reachable at lambda = 1e6, lambda_hat is capped at 1e6 (not observed unless reported).
A3 interval end 'unbounded' is applied per side: an end is None if more than 2.5 % of resamples sit at that infinity.
R-A1 for ORACLE uses the Holm-3 Wilcoxon p (the registered test); the t interval and bootstrap interval must both exclude zero.
